import.title: Import table as a list
import.intro: Choose a .csv or .xlsx file. Its columns become the options of a new list; the columns you do not use as name or label stay as extra columns.
import.noExtras: No extra columns: every column is used as name or label.
import.warnEmpty: {count} empty value(s) in the name column: a name is generated from the label.
import.warnDuplicate: {count} repeated value(s) in the name column: the later ones get a _2, _3 suffix.
import.warnUnsafe: {count} name(s) will be cleaned (accents, spaces, symbols).
import.warnSizePreview: More than {limit} rows: the preview may be slow.
import.warnSizeKobo: More than {limit} rows: Kobo recommends an attached CSV file instead of an internal list.
import.errRead: The file could not be read.
import.errListInvalid: Use letters, numbers and underscores; start with a letter or underscore.

lookup.title: Bring a column from a table
lookup.noOrigins: No select_one question uses a list with extra columns. Import a table first (Choice lists, Import table).
lookup.replaces: This replaces the calculation written now (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
lookup.listMissing: The list {list} does not exist in this form.
lookup.originOtherList: The question {field} uses a different list than {list}.
